mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1627.name: Zillow CLI - Printing Press library
mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1627.blurb: Housing-market CLI and MCP server built on official Zillow Research datasets, no scraping: 17 normalized regional time series, local SQLite sync with read-only SQL and data-quality auditing, and 14 explainable analysis commands (affordability gap, rent-to-value yield proxy, months of inventory, turning points, buy-vs-rent) that show their formulas instead of a black-box score. 57k lines across 173 files. Awaiting upstream review.
